New UI, give feedback on the discord server: discord.gg/blackhub

Join the discord for help

Removed unused features

Added delete config button

🥄 Cooking

Fixed fruit calculator sometimes returning 0

🧪 Mutations & Fruits

Added New Mutations

Added New Plants and Fruits

Added Mutation Check and Mutation ESP

Added Fruit Calculator support for other gardens

⚒️ Automation Features

Auto Craft Gear

Auto Craft Seed

Auto Harvest

Auto Plant

Auto Buy Gear

Auto Buy Eggs

Auto Purchase Seeds

Auto Sell

Auto Summer Harvest Points stopper (fixed)

Auto Shovel

Harvest Aura

🧍 Player Features

WalkSpeed / JumpPower control

Anti-AFK

Customizable Interface

Savable Configuration

Hide Plants

Auto Favourite / Unfavourite

Free Trowel Item [Patched]

🛍️ Shops & Teleports

Added teleport buttons to Pet and Gear Shops

Added “All” option for most shops

Added Instant Spin for seed packs

Added New Summer Event Shop

Added New Traveling Merchant

📦 Webhook Features

Added Webhook logging for pet hatches

Sends hatch info to #pet-hatcher

Now includes all egg data properly

📦 Other

Reworked Pet List UI (may need refresh on first load)
